function tamalePricing(n,mode=selectedOffer()){
  // Best-price bundles do not include drinks. A remaining five forms a family pack.
  // Customers can instead select family-pack pricing to keep each five-tamale offer.
  let bundle20=0,bundle10=0,remaining=n;

  const familyPacks=Math.floor(remaining/5),singles=remaining%5;

}

  const extras=groupTotal([...tacos,...bites,...comforts,...drinks,...salsas]);
  return {totalTamales,pricing,tacoCount,total:pricing.cost+extras};
}

  if(!name||!date||!time){flash('Add your name, pickup date and pickup time.');return null}
  if(date<localDatePlus(1)){flash('Pickup needs at least 1 day notice.');return null}
  const lines=allItems.filter(x=>qty[x.id]).map(x=>`• ${x.name} x${qty[x.id]}`);
  if(t.pricing.freeDrinks)lines.push(`• INCLUDED: ${t.pricing.freeDrinks} free 16 oz agua fresca(s) — ${el('freeDrinkFlavor').value}`);
  const pricing=[];if(t.pricing.bundle20)pricing.push(`${t.pricing.bundle20} × 20 for $100`);if(t.pricing.bundle10)pricing.push(`${t.pricing.bundle10} × 10 for $50`);if(t.pricing.familyPacks)pricing.push(`${t.pricing.familyPacks} × family pack $30`);if(t.pricing.singles)pricing.push(`${t.pricing.singles} × single $6`);
  const toppings=t.totalTamales?`\nTamale toppings: ${checkedToppings('toppings')}`:'';
  const sweet=qty.bites16+qty.bites20?`\nMini bites toppings: ${checkedToppings('sweetToppings')}`:'';
  return `🌽 LOS TAMALEROS PICKUP ORDER\n\nName: ${name}\nPhone: ${phone||'Not provided'}\nPickup: ${date} at ${time}\n\n${lines.join('\n')}${pricing.length?'\n\nTamale offer: '+pricing.join(' + '):''}${toppings}${sweet}\nNotes: ${el('notes').value.trim()||'None'}\nCustomer list: ${el('joinList').checked?'YES — JOIN':'No'}\n\nEstimated total: ${money(t.total)}\n\nPlease confirm availability and final total. Thank you!`;
}
el('sendOrder').addEventListener('click',()=>{const msg=orderMessage();if(msg)window.open(`https://wa.me/${PHONE}?text=${encodeURIComponent(msg)}`,'_blank','noopener')});
function discountForQuantity(n){return n>=300?.15:n>=200?.10:n>=100?.05:0}
const cateringQuantityIds=['classicQty','oaxQty','catTacoPork','catTacoChicken','catTacoCheese','catJamaica','catHorchata','catTamarindo'];
function cateringCalc(){
  const n=id=>{const value=Number(el(id).value);return Number.isFinite(value)?Math.max(0,Math.floor(value)):0};
  const c=n('classicQty'),o=n('oaxQty'),p=n('catTacoPork'),ch=n('catTacoChicken'),che=n('catTacoCheese');
  const jamaica=n('catJamaica'),horchata=n('catHorchata'),tamarindo=n('catTamarindo');
  const tamaleCount=c+o,tacoCount=p+ch+che;
  const salsaLiters=tamaleCount*2/100;
  // The tamale quantity determines the catering tier; that same rate applies to tacos.
  const tamaleDiscount=discountForQuantity(tamaleCount),tacoDiscount=tamaleDiscount;
  const classicBase=c*5,oaxBase=o*6,tamaleBase=classicBase+oaxBase,tamaleTotal=tamaleBase*(1-tamaleDiscount);
  const tacoBase=tacoCount*3,tacoTotal=tacoBase*(1-tacoDiscount);
  const drinksTotal=(jamaica+horchata+tamarindo)*35;
  const total=tamaleTotal+tacoTotal+drinksTotal;
  const line=(label,value)=>`<div class="sum-line"><span>${label}</span><strong>${money(value)}</strong></div>`;
  const rows=[];
  if(c)rows.push(line(`${c} classic tamales · $5 each`,classicBase));
  if(o)rows.push(line(`${o} Oaxaqueños · $6 each`,oaxBase));
  if(tamaleBase)rows.push(line(`Tamale discount · ${Math.round(tamaleDiscount*100)}%`,-(tamaleBase-tamaleTotal)));
  if(tamaleCount)rows.push(`<div class="sum-line"><span>Complimentary salsa · ${Number(salsaLiters.toFixed(2))} L</span><strong>Included</strong></div>`);
  if(tacoCount)rows.push(line(`${tacoCount} tacos · $3 each`,tacoBase));
  if(tacoCount)rows.push(line(`Taco discount · ${Math.round(tacoDiscount*100)}%`,-(tacoBase-tacoTotal)));
  if(jamaica)rows.push(line(`${jamaica} gallon${jamaica===1?'':'s'} Jamaica`,jamaica*35));
  if(horchata)rows.push(line(`${horchata} gallon${horchata===1?'':'s'} Horchata`,horchata*35));
  if(tamarindo)rows.push(line(`${tamarindo} gallon${tamarindo===1?'':'s'} Tamarindo`,tamarindo*35));
  el('catBreakdown').innerHTML=rows.join('')||'<div class="sum-line"><span>Add quantities for an estimate.</span><span>—</span></div>';
  el('catSubtotal').textContent=money(total);
  return {c,o,tamaleCount,salsaLiters,tamaleDiscount,tamaleBase,tamaleTotal,p,ch,che,tacoCount,tacoDiscount,tacoBase,tacoTotal,jamaica,horchata,tamarindo,drinksTotal,total};
}
cateringQuantityIds.forEach(id=>el(id).addEventListener('input',cateringCalc));
cateringCalc();
el('sendCatering').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(cateringQuantityIds.some(id=>!el(id).checkValidity())){flash('Enter whole-number quantities of zero or more.');return}
  const x=cateringCalc(),date=el('eventDate').value,type=el('eventType').value.trim()||'Not specified',loc=el('eventLocation').value.trim(),customer=el('catCustomer').value.trim()||'Not specified',phone=el('catPhone').value.trim()||'Not provided',guests=el('catGuests').value.trim()||'Not specified',notes=el('cateringNotes').value.trim()||'None';
  if(!date||!loc||x.tamaleCount+x.tacoCount===0){flash('Add event date, location, and at least one tamale or taco.');return}
  if(x.tacoCount%2){flash('Tacos are sold in pairs. Add or remove one taco.');return}
  if(date<localDatePlus(1)){flash('Catering requests need at least 1 day notice.');return}
  const credit=el('catCredit').checked?'YES — please check eligibility for the $40 catering credit.':'No credit request';
  const msg=`🎉 LOS TAMALEROS CATERING REQUEST\n\nCustomer/company: ${customer}\nRewards phone: ${phone}\nEvent date: ${date}\nEvent type: ${type}\nLocation: ${loc}\nEstimated guests: ${guests}\n\nClassic tamales: ${x.c} at $5 each\nOaxaqueños: ${x.o} at $6 each\nTamale quantity: ${x.tamaleCount}\nTamale service: Plain, without toppings; served in bulk in heat-retaining cases for guests to distribute.\nComplimentary salsa on the side: ${Number(x.salsaLiters.toFixed(2))} liters (2 liters per 100 tamales).\nTamale discount: ${Math.round(x.tamaleDiscount*100)}%\n\nPork tacos: ${x.p}\nChicken tacos: ${x.ch}\nCheese tacos: ${x.che}\nTotal tacos: ${x.tacoCount}\nTaco discount: ${Math.round(x.tacoDiscount*100)}%\n\nJamaica gallons: ${x.jamaica}\nHorchata gallons: ${x.horchata}\nTamarindo gallons: ${x.tamarindo}\nAguas frescas: $35 per gallon\n\nEstimated subtotal (food + drinks): ${money(x.total)}\n${credit}\nDetails: ${notes}\n\nPlease confirm availability, applicable minimums, payment policy, delivery/service fees, and final quote. Thank you!`;
  window.open(`https://wa.me/${PHONE}?text=${encodeURIComponent(msg)}`,'_blank','noopener');
});
